technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with intermediate-term support (EMA/SMA 20-50) and strong momentum indicators (Supertrend, Ichimoku), but long-term trend weakness (50/200 MA), overbought stochRSI, and below-VWAP price action limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EFX shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 68 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying activity (small amounts, junior members) lacks conviction; broad market fear (42 Fear/Greed score, 40% bearish AAII) presents contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and neutral composite signal prevent strong directional conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 230 crisis level, NFP event today) creates hostile trading environment; 68-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall risk profile is severely elevated.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend, Ichimoku cloud, and OBV bullish signals with price above EMA-20/SMA-50 provide intermediate-term support structure in a fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, NFP event today), long-term trend broken (price below 200-EMA, Hull MA), stochRSI overbought, volume weak (0.6 ratio), and zero fundamental/smart-money conviction make this a high-risk entry into structural weakness.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows intermediate-term bullish structure (Supertrend, Ichimoku, EMA-20/SMA-50 support) in a fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity. However, macro environment is severely hostile with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and NFP event today creating structural headwinds that outweigh technical merit.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 230, NFP volatility) combined with broken long-term trend (price below 200-EMA, Hull MA), zero smart-money conviction, and overbought stochRSI create high probability of mean reversion into weakness despite intermediate-term technicals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bullish signals insufficient to overcome fundamental vacuum, sentiment weakness, and macro crisis environment
